name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Edit Params
description: Admin re-opens the ConfidentialityParamsModal via 'Editar parámetros' on a diagnostic that already has a generated NDA. Form pre-fills from diagnostic.confidentiality_params. Admin modifies one or more fields and submits — the existing DiagnosticAttachment file is replaced in place (same row id, file.delete + file.save, single .save() call). Section header still shows 'Generado el {fecha}' with the updated timestamp.
